title: Loss of survival follow-up after adverse-event-related treatment discontinuation in single-arm and externally controlled glioblastoma trials: simulation code and review data
description: Code, scenario definitions, true values and performance tables for a simulation study of bias from loss of survival follow-up at adverse-event-related treatment discontinuation in single-arm and externally controlled glioblastoma trials, with a coded review of reporting in 76 published single-arm or non-randomised phase II, I/II or Ib/II high-grade glioma trials identified in PubMed Central and PubMed, with all screening decisions and the evidence for every coded value from text, figures and supplementary files.
